scripts.lint:api: uv run --project services/generation-api ruff format --check services/generation-api && uv run --project services/generation-api ruff check services/generation-api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm --filter @press/contracts typecheck
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project services/generation-api mypy services/generation-api/src services/generation-api/scripts
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project services/generation-api python services/generation-api/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm exec openapi-typescript services/generation-api/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated/api.ts && pnpm exec prettier --write services/generation-api/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated/api.ts
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- services/generation-api/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated/api.ts
